scope: Retrospective paired season-level uncertainty-vs-calibrated-production check, all three checkpoints, title calibration; no automatic promotion.
reuse: Reuse frozen uncertainty game/series forecasts and prior-only production fold features. Reconcile common series home court at every checkpoint.
calibration: Same bounded positive logit slope [0.25,4], no intercept, model/target/checkpoint separately, expanding earlier completed-season OOS forecasts only; first three available seasons identity. No pooled October/January duplicates in calibrator training.
title: 10000 persistent season paths per model/checkpoint, fixed seed, same future fixture list and format; calibrated production calibrates single-game and native series probabilities before simulation. Uncertainty keeps the unchanged raw game head and shared strength draw.
formats: Top eight through 2019; 2020 top eight plus 8-v-9 play-in if within four wins (ninth must win twice); 2021 onward modern play-in. Finals 2013 use 2-3-2. Bubble neutral at pre-playoff 2020.
scoring: Title multiclass log loss and summed multiclass Brier per season; Monte Carlo probabilities use additive 0.5 count smoothing, not learned calibration. Team-row reliability bins/ECE are descriptive only. Paired bootstrap resamples whole seasons (2000), and reports each checkpoint separately.
limits: October/January production BPM remains proxy-based; these results are not exact production replays.
Historical future fixtures and pandemic participation/rules are conditioned on as realized, not archived as-of schedules.
Only 14 champions per checkpoint, with dependent checkpoint views of each season; no promotion from this reused cohort.
Post-hoc calibration is distinct for production game and series heads, matching their existing separate roles; not a single generative game calibration.
ui: Production remains default and primary. Experimental odds are explicitly labeled, opt-in, use the unchanged raw uncertainty method, are date-aligned to the primary snapshot, and never replace production on error.
